prologue.t: Echo Drift, this is Mission Control. Thirty-eight years ago a star system started sending a signal.
A signal with a PATTERN. Someone made it.
And we're the lucky crew who gets to find out who! Beep.

intro.t: Cinder. Scorched, cratered… and covered in ruins.
The signal's strongest here. Let's get down there!
Fuel is limited, so let gravity do the work. I read that in a manual. Once.

afterFly.t: Touchdown. Kiran, grab the scanners. We've only got a few charges.

correct.t: An asteroid hit Cinder. But look: they REBUILT on top of it!
So the impact didn't end them. Something bigger did.

wrong.t: Oops. We packed for the wrong danger. Supplies will be tight.

unknown.t: Not sure yet? Good. Let's ask Earth and keep watching.

afterBuild.t: Everyone's alive! Including me, the most important crew member.

afterReport.t: That light-curve dip points to the next Orrin world. Let's power the jump.

outro.t: If they survived that… what got them in the end?

intro.t: Veil's surface is hot enough to melt lead.
Good news: no fuel needed to slow down! Bad news: we use the air instead.
Skim the haze. Not too deep.

afterFly.t: We're in! Scanners up. Those clouds look… suspicious.

correct.t: A runaway greenhouse. But it wasn't their factories. Their STAR got brighter.
The safe zone around the star moved outward… and left Veil behind.

wrong.t: We built for the wrong problem. The base starts low on supplies.

afterBuild.t: Survived the acid storm. My paint job did not.

afterReport.t: Another dip in the starlight. Another world. Let's go.

outro.t: Fragment 2: "OUR SKY GREW WARMER. THE LIGHT GREW STRONGER."
The light grew stronger… they're telling us about their star.

intro.t: Hollow. Look at that star. It's huge.
And there's a black hole nearby with an Orrin probe orbiting it.
Don't worry. I've never been sucked into a black hole. Yet.

afterFly.t: The probe's data is the last piece. Let's scan the surface.

correct.t: It was the star all along. It aged, brightened, and swelled.
Stars like ours do this. Our Sun will too…
…in about 5 billion years! Humans have existed for about 300,000. That's a LOT of time to learn and explore.

wrong.t: Wrong guess. The shields aren't ready. Careful with supplies.

unknown.t: Let's get Earth's view before we decide.

afterBuild.t: Shields held! I am also shiny.

afterReport.t: The signal continues further out. There are more Orrin worlds.

outro.t: Fragment 3: "THE STAR CHANGES. WATCH IT EARLY."
They weren't warning us about danger. They were telling us to keep watching the sky.
Next world: Tides. Coming soon. I'll pack snacks.

burnup: Kiran: "Too deep! The air turned to fire."
Tobo: "I am now a toasted robot."
horizon: Kiran: "We crossed the event horizon. Not even light gets out of there!"
lost: Asha: "We're drifting off the map. Let's try that again."
timeout: Tobo: "I fell asleep. Did we get there?"
success3: Asha: "Textbook flying. No, better than the textbook."
success1: Tobo: "We made it! Mostly in one piece."
Asha: "Got there. Next time, less fuel?"
fuelSaver: Kiran: "You let gravity do the work. That's how the pros fly."
nudge: Kiran: "Great place for a break. The stars will still be here!"
